visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman stands center stage, dressed in a red sleeveless qipao-style top with pink arm sleeves and a black belt, wearing a Naruto-themed headband. She holds a silver flute to her lips, fingers moving rapidly over the keys as she performs. In the background, several musicians in formal wear play violins under bright, warm stage lights. (2) The camera pans slightly, showing more of the string section; a man and two women are visible playing their instruments with focus. The background features a large pink banner with stylized anime graphics and the text 'KAMEHAMEHA'. (3) A side view reveals a conductor with long dark hair and a black suit, waving a baton in time with the music. The flutist sways her body rhythmically, her eyes focused on her instrument while her mouth maintains a precise embouchure. (4) The camera zooms in on the flutist's face and hands, capturing the intricate finger movements and her concentrated expression. Pink and yellow lights reflect off the silver surface of the flute. (5) As the performance concludes, the woman lowers her flute and bows deeply toward the camera and the audience. Blurred figures in the foreground are seen holding up smartphones to record the event, and the orchestra members behind her also finish their motions.
